Treat any listed local opaque/constant/axiom type head as requiring a checked carrier/refinement bridge before it is ordinary model data. Treat every opaque, ambiguous, tactic-body, or bounded terminal term path as requiring a checked semantic bridge before it is treated as an ordinary numeric or propositional result. Do not infer a source model from any local Lean name. For every dimension, record a source locator, a concrete semantic comparison, and Lean evidence; a detected support, joint-law/state-evolution, conditioning/calibration, expectation-definedness, null-cell/partition, or extended-rate shape also needs a checked bridge declaration or constructor route. For every detected probability-law surface, explicitly compare the source and Lean parameterizations rather than merely saying their parameters are positively related: state both scale/rate/variance conventions, the translation formula, and a checked law or outcome bridge. When the generated joint-law dimension requests source-carrier coherence analysis, identify the source and Lean random-variable carriers, explain why stagewise clocks are one joint source draw (or a source-defined kernel composition) rather than resampling, classify the measure transport, and record any all-rate family bridge. This individual row has an explicit source-presentation-selected direct map route. The association binds its byte-verified source item and current elaborated signature; it does not assert a direct/Spec structural equivalence.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded binder/result type surface
dimensions.required_check: Compare every expanded Lean binder domain, result quantifier, and proposition against the literal source statement. Check direction, scope, endpoint, and fixed-versus-uniform quantification; alpha-renaming is not a semantic change. For every formula used as a transformed density, likelihood, kernel, or probability law, check its sign, normalization, and Jacobian factor across the entire declared parameter domain. An algebraic scaling formula is not a probability-law conclusion outside the domain where those facts are proved.

expanded_shape_basis: generic, finite, subtype, or opaque carrier surface
expanded finite carrier requiring boundary-case review
finite carrier with nontrivial index arithmetic
dimensions.required_check: Compare the Lean carrier, finiteness/order/subtype restrictions, and every generic Type/Sort quantifier with the source domain. An arbitrary carrier or a silently strengthened finite carrier needs a source anchor or a checked bridge. When an expanded finite carrier encodes a source cardinal parameter through index arithmetic such as Fin (n + c), state the source parameter, the Lean expression, and a proved translation; local type names and inferred cardinality are not evidence. When a strict conclusion needs distinct, non-endpoint, or interior carrier elements, derive the exact cardinality threshold and witness from the source; a bare source phrase such as 'n candidates' does not supply N >= 3. When the generated surface requests a cardinality-boundary analysis, record the source and Lean cardinal domains, every smallest/endpoint case checked, and either the strictness witness or a semantic reason no such witness is needed. A theorem, wrapper, or carrier name is not that analysis. A local opaque/constant/axiom carrier must expose a checked refinement before it is treated as ordinary model data.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type with finite or ordered carrier
transparent terminal definition closure with finite or ordered probability construct
dimensions.required_check: For a finite/ordered probabilistic model, derive support at each endpoint from the source condition actually stated. Strict adjacent-tail comparisons do not by themselves supply a terminal cutoff or positive top/bottom atom; inspect zero mass, degenerate, and boundary cases separately.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type surface
transparent terminal definition closure with probability or integration construct
dimensions.required_check: Identify the source stochastic process and the Lean joint law separately. Do not replace a source state recurrence, conditioning rule, or time-indexed law with an iid/product construction without a Lean-checked equality, simulation, or refinement from the source primitives. If either side sorts, ranks, relabels, or quotients samples before computing an outcome, prove the corresponding pushforward and outcome-equivariance bridge; matching marginal tables or an informal exchangeability argument is not enough. When the generated surface requests transformed-law analysis, record the source and Lean operations, the full parameter domain including sign/zero endpoints, normalization or pushforward evidence, and outcome-equivariance evidence (or an explicit semantic no-transform/no-relabeling finding). Separately write the source and Lean distribution parameterizations: the exact scale/rate/precision/standard-deviation/variance convention, the parameter mapping formula, and a checked law equality or outcome-preservation bridge. A positive reparameterization or matching declaration name is not a law-equivalence argument. When a standard Measure/Kernel carrier transport is present, identify the source carrier and the Lean carrier, show whether every stage is one joint draw or a source-defined conditional kernel composition, and classify the measure as a source pushforward, source conditioning/restriction, source-defined joint kernel law, generated product/kernel measure, or weighted/tilted measure. A weighted likelihood measure is not a source pushforward without an explicit transport theorem. A rate-free or rate-indexed source claim needs a checked rate-indexed family bridge, not one selected Lean rate.

State exactly whether source and Lean use a pointwise conditional law, an almost-everywhere conditional version, positive-fiber identities, or measurable-event calibration. Expand the event, sigma-algebra/measurability, and joint-law formula; a statement about exact fibers does not silently determine atomless or null fibers. Any switch among these semantics needs a Lean-checked bridge, not a source-looking conditional-probability or calibration name.

expanded_shape_basis: transparent terminal definition closure with integration or expectation construct
dimensions.required_check: For every source or Lean expectation/integral reached through this model, identify the law and integrand and establish the exact definedness convention: measurability or a.e.-measurability, integrability/finite integral, or an explicitly extended-value integral. A displayed E[...] is not a total Real number merely because a predictor or classifier was named; indicator and strategy correctness functions require their own measurability/integrability bridge.

For every conditioning/partition formula reached through this model, compare finite, countable, and arbitrary partition scope; cell measurability, disjointness, and cover on the relevant support; and the value assigned when a cell has zero mass. Expand every ratio/branch used to totalize zero denominators. A finite measurable-cell proof or a positive-mass-only identity does not cover an advertised arbitrary partition without a Lean-checked refinement.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded extended-rate codomain surface
dimensions.required_check: Compare the source rate codomain with the Lean codomain after unfolding the rate definition. A Real-valued formula is not automatically a WithTop/extended-real statement: account for eventual-zero events, infinite rates, zero sample counts, and boundary minimizers.
